text: Banca Popolare del Frusinate is a Frosinone-based 'Societa Cooperativa per Azioni' with share capital of EUR 31,883,700 fully paid as at 31 December 2025 - i.e. owned by its own member-shareholders rather than by a listed or state parent. Italian cooperative banks carry no state equity. Record is unremarkable at this size; its Frosinone/Lazio lending limits human-rights relevance to ordinary banking conduct.
